observations.why: Present-tense directive seeking a non-actual future state (knowledge removed); 'all knowledge of zeppelin routes' operates at a categorical rather than event-specific level — abstract construal.
Directive to discard prior knowledge appeals to conservation — controlling what is retained and purging what no longer belongs, a stability-of-information move.

Parallel imperative formula 'Remove all knowledge of' mirrors src-1's directive template — a second instance of the same stock command pattern for erasure.
